name: lotsofsounds
description: Search, inspect, and download CC0 royalty-free sound effects, UI sounds, game audio, and ambience from Lots of Sounds.

interface.shortDescription: Find and download CC0 sound effects
interface.longDescription: Search and download 17,000+ CC0 royalty-free sound effects, UI cues, game audio, and ambience from Lots of Sounds. Free sample browsing works without an API key; full-catalog search and downloads use an API key.
capabilities: Browse curated free CC0 sample sounds without an API key
Search the full catalog by keyword, tags, category, and duration
Inspect sound metadata and fetch time-limited signed download URLs
defaultPrompt: Find a short, calm notification chime for an AI assistant.
Find five ambient rain sounds under 10 seconds.
Add a CC0 button click sound to my project.
